lines.en: I head over to the school, finally free from my duty as the coach of the soccer team- a position I was forced into by the very girl I am here to see right now.
lines.zh: 我往学校走去，总算摆脱了足球队教练的职务——而这个职位，正是被我现在要来见的这个女孩硬塞给我的。

lines.en: But, and I’m sorry to Miku for thinking this, I kind of prefer things this way.
lines.zh: 不过——虽然这么想对 Miku 有点抱歉——我其实更喜欢现在这样。

lines.en: Sure, there are {i}fewer{/i} girls around seeing as the swim club has barely enough members to stay afloat (Pun not intended)-
lines.zh: 当然，周围的女生{i}少了些{/i}，毕竟游泳社的人数勉强够维持不沉下去（此处并非双关）——

lines.en: But there are more girls I {i}know{/i} here, which greatly increases my chances of ultimately getting to sleep with them in their school swimsuit.
lines.zh: 但我{i}认识{/i}的女生在这儿更多，这大大提高了我最终能和她们穿着学校泳装共度春宵的概率。

lines.en: Regardless of my inability to keep my mind out of the gutter after seeing Miku’s surprisingly toned yet alluringly slender body, I’m happy she was able to fit in here as quickly as she did.
lines.zh: 尽管看到 Miku 那意外紧致、又诱人纤细的身体之后，我完全没法把脑子从下流的念头里拉出来，但我还是很高兴她能这么快就融入这里。

lines.en: I’m sure it was difficult giving up the one thing she really loved doing, but athletes will be athletes no matter what sport they’re thrown into.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，放弃她唯一真正热爱的事一定很难，但运动员就是运动员，不管被丢进哪项运动里都一样。

lines.en: And as long as it involves intense physical activity and an overabundance of energy, I’m sure Miku will be fine.
lines.zh: 而只要这件事需要高强度的体能和过剩的精力，我敢肯定 Miku 就不会有问题。

lines.en: In thinking that, my mind quickly falls back into the gutter and I wind up staring at Miku for long enough to disturb her.
lines.zh: 这么一想，我的脑子又迅速掉回阴沟里，结果我盯着 Miku 看了很久，久到让她不自在了。

lines.en: But that’s fine, because instead of asking me to {i}stop{/i} looking at her, she just blushes and looks away, pretending to not notice.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，因为她没有叫我{i}别{/i}看她，只是红着脸别开视线，装作没注意到。

lines.en: It may have taken several cycles of the world to get here, but I’m glad we’ve reached a point where she is well aware of the way I look at her.
lines.zh: 虽然这个世界重来了好几个轮回才走到这一步，但我很高兴，我们终于到了她清楚地知道我是怎么看她的地步。

lines.en: But I’m even gladder that we’ve reached a point where I can capitalize on that.
lines.zh: 但我更高兴的是，我们到了我可以利用这一点的地步。
